substantive_decision.name: LOCK_OWNERSHIP_REPLACEMENT_IS_OPERATOR_RECOVERY_SAFETY_GATE
substantive_decision.source_observation: storage.ArchiveWriterLock.__enter__ now inode/dev-checks cleanup on PID-write failure, but __exit__ unconditionally unlinks lock_path if it exists. If an operator removes/replaces a lock while its prior owner is still alive, that owner can unlink the replacement at exit. This is a recovery/interleaving hazard, not a proven normal two-writer defect.
substantive_decision.generation_scope: Three-file generation test is characterization only; cf-anata-handoff-v1 is documented consumer. Do not promote mixed generations to confirmed defect absent a consumer requiring all three files atomically.
no_network_test_contract: Disposable tmp_path archive; enter ArchiveWriterLock and capture lstat inode/dev of .jsonl.lock; while original context remains live, rename that lock to a test-owned backup and create a replacement .lock with a distinct inode and sentinel text. Exit original context.

Assert replacement sentinel/inode survive old owner's __exit__; current source predicts assertion failure because __exit__ unlinks by path without ownership check. Cleanup only test-owned files in finally. This deliberately models unsafe operator recovery; do not run against real archives.

Separate positive controls: clean-path ENOSPC test leaves no newly created lock and reacquires; preexisting sentinel times out unchanged; real spawned child exits 17 and leaves orphan fail-closed. Assert all three exact node IDs and subprocess exit codes.

Run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_reader_writer_visibility.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests; record exact checkout SHA and exit codes. No network.
substantive_decision.operational_recovery: Until a verified recovery protocol exists, never auto-reap orphan locks. Operator must prove no live owner, verify stable lock identity and archive integrity, and avoid replacing lock while an owner is active. No new Gemini task justified; queue empty but JSON reliability unverified.
